text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —A special movie?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, apparently all the community members 
made it together.

text_block_list.text:
One day, members of the community shared a 
video showcasing Loves Only You's career 
track record up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see, I wanna see, I wanna see! 
Let's go watch it together right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder what kind of footage it'll 
be...! I'm so excited...!!

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
“—These are the hoofprints of a certain 
Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"‘The days of trials and glory for the one 
who will soon take flight to the world—’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's me from way back?! This is 
probably right around when my community 
was set up! Whoa~, talk about nostalgia~!
choice_data_list: Your form was great even back then.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, THAT'S where you're looking!?

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"—Enrolling in Tracen Academy, pushing 
each other to the limit in order to become 
the Umamusume that define an era—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange. It feels like such a long 
time ago, yet it feels like just the other 
day—

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, she crosses paths with a partner 
with whom she will run towards the 
future."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"There he is, Trainer-kun! Still looking a 
bit fresh and green♪"
choice_data_list: Th-This is so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"There she is, Trainer-chan! Still looking 
a bit fresh and green♪"
choice_data_list: Th-This is so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—Let us forge our contract. Before 
everyone gathered here."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah♪ How bo~ld♡
choice_data_list: But you're the one who said it...
But you're the one who said it...

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"—Even when faced with immense adversity 
at times, she never, ever gave up on her 
dream—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪ Though that's all thanks to the 
committee members too♪
choice_data_list: A lot really happened back then, huh...

A lot really happened back then, didn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"—Experiencing both glory and defeat, she 
pushes forward with unwavering strength."

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
"Embracing love, and for the sake of 
love."

text_block_list.name: On-Screen Text
text_block_list.text:
""Thank you for loving us. Thank you for 
letting us love you.""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 『Thank you Loves Only You』

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list: ...That was a wonderful video.
...That was a wonderful video.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...All of our love has been poured 
into it so carefully—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It really feels... like the 
crystallization of love ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I need to share my thoughts with the 
commu-members! Maybe I'll even do a 
watch-along stream~♪
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone will be thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ That's love right there~♡

...After that, Loves Only You would 
occasionally re-watch this video and bask 
in the memories—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's okay to post this video 
publicly on UmaTube or something?
choice_data_list:
I'll ask if it's okay with everyone, but 
why?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted lots of different 
people to watch me and get to know me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The super lovely bond between me and my 
commu-members♪
choice_data_list: ...I see, that's just like Loves.

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with the community members' 
enthusiastic approval, the video was 
published publicly to the world—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh~... Loves Only You really had a tough 
journey, huh. Seeing her hoofprints makes 
it all feel so touching...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That connection with the community is 
wonderful. They've watched over you for so 
long, haven't they...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I knew you two got along well with your 
Trainer, but I see, so that's how you met.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ So many people are leaving comments, 
it's so so lovely♡

This became a new opportunity for racing 
fans to turn their attention to the 
relationship between Loves Only You and 
her community members.

text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Public Opinion
text_block_list.text:
"So wholesome" "I ship it" "Hits right in 
the feels..." "So dramatic" "M O V I E A D 
A P T A T I O N W H E N" "Great story" 
"Truth is stranger than fiction" "I'm 
tearing up"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Wait... is this going viral!?

The released movie became a hot topic 
among race fans, far exceeding initial 
expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it was my idea to begin with, 
I never imagined so many people would 
watch it...!"
choice_data_list: The community members were happy too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ It feels like everyone is giving us 
their blessing, it's so, so lovely♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? This comment......—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-kun! Someone 
commented: "I've gotten a little curious 
about Loves Only You and Trainer's daily 
life"!
choice_data_list: Huh, why!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-chan! Someone 
commented: "I've gotten a little curious 
about Loves Only You and Trainer's daily 
life"!
choice_data_list: Huh, why!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously it's because we showed our 
lovely bond in the video, right? ♪ We've 
gotta answer to voices like that ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
For now, wanna film a dance video 
together? Or maybe playing games side by 
side works too~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, cooking together could be super 
romantic too! Wait, if we do that—
choice_data_list: Um, Loves-san...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Costume swap...? Classic training 
scenes...? Or maybe we should just shoot 
everything...?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, we can't just sit around! 
Emergency planning meeting, now!
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, looks like I just flipped a switch 
or something...!?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, we can't just sit around! 
It's time for an emergency strategy 
meeting!
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, looks like I just flipped a switch 
or something...!?)

text_block_list.text:
...Though, as long as she looks happy, I 
guess that's fine.

Watching her smile, those feelings 
naturally welled up inside me—
